Definition: Gedaljah, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Gedaliah is a person named 31 times in Scripture, in 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and Ezra. The full story lives on the Gedaliah profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Gedaliah in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile; The Murder of Gedaliah
